hero.caption: The interface transitions from a dark, immersive night sky to a bright daytime vista, then showcases the virtual reality mode experience.

chat.caption: The AI assistant plans a Saturday, automatically generating calendar events and a task with a reminder based on a user's request.

business.caption: A request to add a client with an outstanding balance automatically generates a new client record and a payment reminder within the system.

coding.caption: The coding studio scans Python dependencies for vulnerabilities, reports findings, and then opens a code editor for remediation.

status.caption: The app continuously monitors all components, displaying real-time status and latency, while confirming AI responses from local models.
